title: Bash
source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
name="world"
greet() {
  local value="${name^^}"
  if [[ -n "$value" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$value"
  fi
}
for file in *.txt; do greet "$file"; done
cat <<EOF
Hello $name
EOF
# normal comment
